artifact: PulseForge SNMP MIB/OID leaf inventory (Workstream B)

verification_rules.VERIFIED_AS_IS: engine name+OID equals (or is an instance under) the declaration in the engine-cited pinned authority module
verification_rules.VERIFIED_AFTER_CORRECTION: engine row wrong; corrected name/oid/module re-derived from the pinned authority at build time
verification_rules.VERIFIED_AFTER_MODULE_REASSIGNMENT: ipRoute* only: OIDs valid per RFC 1213 SMIv1 implicit numbering; module must be RFC1213-MIB, not IP-MIB
verification_rules.REJECTED_NO_AUTHORITY: name and OID unsupported by any pinned authority; must not be cited as coverage

authority_verification.tree_blob_integrity: git blob sha1 of each committed file equals the pinned tree entry
authority_verification.pysnmp_index_role: SECONDARY coarse authority: module -> registered OID-subtree index (two columns: module,oid). NOT a leaf catalog; used only for module existence + coarse subtree claims.
